item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows sun-heated land warming the moist air above a school playground. Siddharth watches the air rise and a dark cloud form before a thunderstorm begins.

Which claim correctly describes the chain that produces the thunderstorm?

options.A: Warm moist air rises over the heated land, leaving a low-pressure area; cooler air then flows in and the rising moist air forms the cloud.
options.B: Cool dry air sinks first over the heated land and that sinking alone forms the thunderstorm cloud.
options.C: Warm moist air need not rise; a thunderstorm cloud still forms over the heated land.
options.D: The dark cloud forms only because the cloud shape in the diagram looks dark.
